title: Validate legacy hosts built with the pre-scene-required SDK
runtime_toolchain: Rediscover Xcode27 and actual available iOS27.0/26.5 simulators independently of the build toolchain.
admission: EXP-188 confirms SDK27-built legacy-host launch enforcement. Apple documents that it depends on the build SDK. An installed real SDK26.5 allows the customer-relevant older-built legacy contract to be tested without patching or bypassing UIKit.
fixture_basis: Original EXP-160 navigation fixture and its separately identified actual-lifecycle variant. Keep exact mapper ownership/occurrence assertions and source inputs; any required fixture-only adaptation must be identified before execution.
readiness: Build only the baseline navigation host with the genuine26.5 SDK, verify Mach-O/Info.plist/installed identity and absent scene manifest, and run automatic navigation on27.0 once. Stop on any non-PASS; no candidate build until this control passes.
decisive_oracle: Fresh run identifier and clean app/data absence; exact archived source, fixture, build SDK, deployment target and installed binary identity.
No UIApplicationSceneManifest; no scene-registry dependency in the legacy host.
Automatic/manual Home -> Detail -> fresh Home with distinct occurrences and exactly one correctly owned Action and Resource per marker.

Actual OS background/foreground after fresh run-bound readiness; automatic stops and creates fresh Home, manual retains Home; markers match exact owners and lifecycle notifications occur before result.
All16 unique cells pass the unchanged semantic contract; missing cells, stale readiness/results, wrong owners, duplicates or lifecycle substitutions cannot pass.
Prove process/data cleanup for each fixture, restore simulators booted by the run, and preserve both user-owned paths.
closure_rule: C03 closes only when the complete genuine-SDK26.5 legacy matrix passes. SDK27-built manifest-less hosts remain a documented Apple launch restriction; EXP-160/188 failures remain preserved. No C06, physical topology, performance or final Release matrix claim.
prohibited_shortcuts: No SDK-version or binary patching, assertion suppression, debugger launch, scene manifest, synthetic lifecycle notification, test-threshold relaxation or source change.
No repeated accepted telemetry or performance matrix.
No production SDK change, public API promotion, protected-path access or push.
